frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Mother Board, it's good to see you online again.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: THANK YOU, TRAVELLER. YOUR EFFORTS HAVE RESTORED THE BEAT TO ELECTRONOVA. YOU HAVE AWAKENED US FROM OUR SILENCE AND BROUGHT BACK OUR RHYTHM.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: It was a team effort. Diode, Circuitus, and everyone else played their part.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: YOUR HUMILITY IS ADMIRABLE. THE TECHNO POWER RESURGENCE IS NOW IN FULL EFFECT. THE GRAND COMPOSER'S INFLUENCE WILL BE PURGED FROM OUR SYSTEMS.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: AS A TOKEN OF OUR GRATITUDE, I WILL ASSIST YOU IN REPAIRING YOUR SHIP. ALSO, TAKE THIS CELESTIAL AMP TO AID YOU ON YOUR JOURNEY.

frames.heading: Celestial Amp
frames.body: Another amp from Mother Board? I wonder what their purpose is...

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Mother Board. You've been a big help.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: YOUR JOURNEY IS FAR FROM OVER, TRAVELLER. BEYOND THE WAVES LIES AMPIFORIA, HOME TO THE ROCK PEOPLE. THEY, TOO, MAY NEED YOUR AID.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Ampiforia, huh? Sounds like my kind of adventure. I'll head there next.
